_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,710 stores in 50 states and Canada with 193 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and commercial business customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,710 stores in 50 states and Canada with 193 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and commercial business customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.12x; +30% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.15; conservative 2yr +15%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -19.9%/yr (worst year FY00-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.3%/yr (Q4 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.3%/yr (FY00-FY09 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +35.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY00-FY09); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2010-12-17) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.12x (48.4% downside to Bear $13 / +43.0% upside to Bull $36) | Adj composite 2.21 vs market 2.36: gap -0.15 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +30% above the EPP floor $19 (14x FY10E $1.39) | Conservative 2-yr case: +15.3% total (+7.6%/yr) | At 18.2x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $33 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; comps +0.2% in Q3 FY10, forward sales +2-4% (Q4 FY10 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
